risks: A fulfilled Promise<void> from emit can represent silently dropped or failed delivery; acking it loses committed domain events.
Crash after effect before ack duplicates native effects unless existing command/occurrence receipts use stable event/effect identity; RetryScheduler does not supply this guarantee.
Bus onAny handlers receive payloads too; title/attrs/oldValue/newValue must be policy-safe before dispatch, not merely redacted when UI reads history.
History JSONL compaction and process-local mutex are presentation/serialization mechanisms, not durable dedup/lease/receipt authorities.
Task alias and Base field event are not proved by the three explicit DAG dependencies alone; casting to AutomationEvent or mapping to session status would conceal missing foundation.
Published RS-AUT-01 requires draft/published cutover in its first slice and depends on RS-AUT-03 for activation; coarse issue-level scheduling hides this staged capability dependency.
Current RPC client/workspace context is not by itself a current workflow principal. Event actorRef is provenance, never authorization; resume must reauthorize after revoke.
Required renderer-facing contracts/history UI cannot be completed inside currently listed writable seams. Packet expansion must precede extra source edits, not retrospective justification.
Working tree may change during wave0. Whole-file hashes bind evidence; lineage validation success is only momentary report compatibility, not feature correctness or accepted dependency readiness.
Core event aliases must not introduce a core-to-shared/server implementation dependency inversion; use pure descriptor contracts and bind to the existing registry at the adapter seam.
No runtime/UI/provider evidence is claimed. All full-feature DoD items remain open despite completion of this preflight artifact.
